text: devadattasuttaṃ [609] evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate acirapakkante devadatte . atha kho brahmā sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ gijjhakūṭaṃ [1]- obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi . [610] ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho brahmā sahampati devadattaṃ ārabbha bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi phalaṃ ve kaddaliṃ hanti phalaṃ veḷaḷa phalaṃ naḷaṃ sakkāro kāpurisaṃ hanti gabbho assatariṃ yathāti . tatiyaṃ
